source: BMKG RepoGempa exported CSV; not a complete or authoritative hazard catalog
source_file: CSV gabungan BMKG RepoGempa yang diaudit untuk EarthAlert (master disimpan pada paket audit penelitian terpisah)

features.frequency: ln(1+number of catalog records with magnitude>=floor) per spatial unit over 2016-2025
features.depth: ln(1+median depth km) per spatial unit

validation: WCSS, Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz and leave-one-year-out ARI on matching cells
scope_limitations: Historical clustering is not earthquake hazard, risk, safe/unsafe or building damage estimation.
Absolute frequencies not corrected for incomplete catalog or changing completeness.
Raw types of earthquake magnitude may vary; 2016-25 Mag Type missing in the files.
No geologic faults or plate boundaries used for clustering.
Records on dates with no exported data cannot be assumed to be true zero events.
